# Minutes & Email Templates

```markdown

**Date:** 2026-08-12 · **Items:** 6 actions, 3 decisions, 2 open questions

## Decisions
1. Postpone launch to Q4 (line 14)
2. Going with Stripe for payments (line 22)

## Action Items
| # | Action | Owner | Due | Flags |
|---|--------|-------|-----|-------|
| 1 | Send revised deck to leadership | Sarah | Fri 2026-08-14 | — |
| 2 | Review vendor contract | Unassigned | — | needs owner |
| 3 | Set up payment sandbox | Tom | Fri 2026-08-14 | confirm acceptance |
```

## Summary email (generated by `--email`)

```
Subject: [Product Sync 2026-08-12] Decisions + your action items

Team — summary from today's Product Sync.

DECISIONS
• Postpone launch to Q4
• Going with Stripe for payments

YOUR ACTION ITEMS

  1. Set up payment sandbox — by Fri Aug 14 (please confirm)

UNASSIGNED (volunteer needed)
  1. Review vendor contract

OPEN QUESTIONS

Full minutes attached. Reply with corrections within 24h; otherwise
this stands as our record.
```

## Format variants by meeting type

**Standup:** suppress decisions section; actions only; carryover is the main
content (yesterday's unfinished items). Email subject: `[standup YYYY-MM-DD]
blockers + carries`.

**1:1s:** actions become mutual commitments — render as two sections ("You
committed to", "They committed to"). No email output; keep as shared doc.

**Exec/stakeholder:** decisions first, one-line risk section, no per-owner
task lists (those go to the doers separately). Cap at 10 bullets; link full
minutes.

**Workshop/retro:** group actions by theme column (e.g., retro's
start/stop/continue); decisions rare; questions dominate.

## Editing before distribution

The extractor flags what it's unsure about (`review before sending`,
`confirm acceptance`, `needs owner`). Human pass:

1. Assign the Unassigned items (or drop them if they were brainstorm noise)
2. Confirm question-flagged delegations were actually accepted
3. Verify deadlines that came from vague phrases ("end of week" — which Friday?)
4. Delete items that were hypothetical discussion

The email's "reply with corrections" line is the safety net — use it.

## Storage convention

Keep one JSON per meeting in a folder:

```
meetings/
  2026-08-05-product-sync.json
  2026-08-12-product-sync.json
```

`--previous` takes last week's file; carryover keeps recurring meetings honest.
Quarterly: grep the JSONs for `stale: true` to find zombie commitments.
